_comment: iBM Lab 文献捕获桥共享安全 spec（单点事实源）。三处实现必须消费本文件或与本文件保持一致，防安全边界漂移：browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/background.js（MV3 SW 异步加载扩展内副本）、browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/native-bridge/host.py（开发回退桥）、desktop/src-tauri/resources/bridge/host.js（桌面原生宿主）。两处镜像文件必须逐字节一致：browser-extension/ibm-literature-capture/capture-spec.json 与 desktop/src-tauri/resources/bridge/capture-spec.json（tests/unit/native-bridge-host.test.mjs 断言）。
